questions.statement: Which word names the sport where players kick a ball and try to score in a goal?
questions.context: Clase de ingles de tercer grado en la que los estudiantes ven la lista de deportes del colegio.

options.feedback: Soccer is the sport in which a ball is kicked and you try to score in a goal.
In basketball the ball goes in with the hands and the hoop is up high, not in a goal.
In swimming the player moves through the water and there is no goal to score in.
In tennis the ball is hit with a racket and the point is not scored in a goal.

questions.explanation: Para distinguir deportes en ingles basta identificar dos rasgos: como se mueve el objeto y donde se marca el punto. Soccer tiene las dos caracteristicas del enunciado, patear y porteria, mientras que las demas opciones se descartan por el uso de las manos, el agua o la raqueta.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence correctly pairs the sport with the place where it is played?
questions.context: Ejercicio de emparejamiento de deportes con el lugar donde se practican.

options.text: We swim in the swimming pool.
options.feedback: Swimming in a pool is a correct pairing in itself, but it is swimming and not basketball, so it does not match the sport the prompt is asking about.

options.text: We play basketball on the court.
options.feedback: Basketball is played on a court, and on the court is the combination students use in English.

options.text: We play soccer in the swimming pool.
options.feedback: Soccer is played on a football pitch, not in a swimming pool, even though both words are real.

options.text: We play tennis in the ring.
options.feedback: Tennis is played on a court and with a racket; the ring is not a playing space at all.

questions.explanation: Cada deporte tiene un espacio propio, y la combinacion correcta se memoriza como bloque: play soccer on the field, play basketball on the court, play tennis on the court, swim in the pool. Reconocer el espacio equivocado es tan importante como reconocer el nombre del deporte.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Ana likes swimming because she wants to be healthy." Why does Ana like swimming?
questions.context: Lectura de un texto sobre la clase de educacion fisica de los estudiantes.

options.text: Because she wants to win a race
options.feedback: The text does not mention a race or wanting to win a competition.
The text does not talk about the pool or about liking the place where she swims.

options.text: Because she wants to be healthy
options.feedback: The second part of the text says literally that she wants to be healthy.

options.text: Because her friends swim with her
options.feedback: No friend or company is mentioned in the sentence.

questions.explanation: La palabra because introduce la razon y siempre enlaza con la segunda mitad de la oracion. Reconocer el conector causal permite responder preguntas de motivo sin inventar informacion que no aparece en el texto, que es el error tipico en comprension de grado tercero.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which question finds out about a team sport?
questions.context: Dialogo entre classmates sobre los deportes que hacen en el tiempo libre.

options.feedback: That question is about food and has nothing to do with sports or teams.

options.text: Do you play on a team?
options.feedback: On a team defines a team sport, and that question identifies exactly the feature being looked for.
That question is about the student's house and not about sporting practice.
That question asks for the age of a relative and gives no information at all about the sport.

questions.explanation: Los deportes se clasifican en individuales y de equipo, y la diferencia se expresa con expresiones concretas como on a team o alone. Preguntar por esa caracteristica es la manera correcta de clasificar, mientras que las demas opciones cambian de tema y no ofrecen informacion util.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: In soccer, players need this to kick the ball. What is it?
questions.context: Ejercicio de vocabulario sobre el equipo y el material de un deporte.

options.feedback: The ball is the object that is kicked in football, which is exactly what the sentence asks for.
The racket is used in tennis and badminton, and it has no function in football.
The net is placed on the goal or across the pitch, but it is not the object the player hits.
The bat belongs to baseball and softball, sports in which the ball is hit with the hands.

questions.explanation: Agrupar el material por deporte ayuda a retener el vocabulario: racket for tennis, bat for baseball, ball for soccer and basketball, net for volleyball. Cuando el enunciado nombra una accion, el objeto que la corresponde identifica por si solo la opcion correcta.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct word: "Run to the wall and then ___ back to the line."
questions.context: Rutina de educacion fisica en la que el docente da instrucciones al grupo.

options.feedback: comes agrees with a third person subject, and the sentence is addressed to the students.
come is the present form that agrees with the group of students the teacher is addressing.
coming is the -ing form and needs an auxiliary verb in front of it, like is coming.
The verb to come is irregular and its past is came, but the sentence is in the present.

questions.explanation: Las instrucciones de clase suelen dirigirse a un grupo, y ese grupo se trata como usted, por lo que el verbo aparece en la forma de you. Reconocer a quien se dirige la oracion evita el error de conjugar en tercera persona cuando en realidad se habla con varios estudiantes.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Playing sports helps children stay strong and makes them happy." What is the main benefit mentioned?
questions.context: Lectura de un articulo sobre los deportes mas practicados en la escuela.

options.feedback: The text does not mention grades or school performance.
The text names exactly those two benefits, strong and happy.
The text does not talk about friendships or social relationships.
Swimming does not appear in the text, which talks about sports in general.

questions.explanation: La idea principal suele aparecer resumida al final del texto. Las tres opciones incorrectas introducen temas que el lector podria suponer por el contexto general del deporte, y por eso son distractores utiles: obligan a volver al texto para confirmar la informacion.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which answer is the best one for a student who plays soccer on Saturdays?
questions.context: Actividad final donde cada estudiante presenta el deporte que mas le gusta.

options.feedback: That answer names a sport different from the one the prompt gives to the student.
That sentence shows a general opinion and does not identify any specific sport.
That answer includes a day and a sport that do not match Saturdays or football.
The answer repeats the sport and the day from the prompt, which is how to present the complete information.

questions.explanation: La oracion completa debe reunir las dos piezas de informacion del ejercicio: el deporte y el momento en que se practica. Una respuesta con opinion general es gramaticalmente correcta pero pierde los datos que la consigna pide, y por eso no es aceptable como respuesta final.
questions.subject: ingles
